_comment: Every rejection body the ACARS routes can produce, keyed by the case. The HTTP status is the first token of the key. Frozen in design.md section 5.4; T-002 pastes these strings verbatim.

400 neither canned_id nor body.error: canned_id must be one of: wx-request, gate-request, request-pushback

400 unknown canned_id.error: canned_id must be one of: wx-request, gate-request, request-pushback

400 body not in the canned set.error: Only canned messages can be sent from a client. Free text is not accepted.

403 direction not downlink.error: A client may only send downlink messages

403 category disagrees with the canned e.error: category must be freetext for canned message request-pushback
